component.name: BiD
component.summary: Mixer for Audient iD audio interfaces

description.p: Unofficial control panel and mixer for the Audient iD series USB audio interfaces on Linux: mixes and cues, routing, loopback, VU meters and the full monitor section, over the interface's spare USB port so audio keeps playing while the mixer is open.
Verified on the iD24; the iD4, iD14, iD22, iD44 and iD48 are inherited from the device list and welcome testing. The host needs a one-line udev rule for USB access, described in the project README.

screenshot.caption: The mixer: strips with meters, the mix tabs, and the monitor section
